advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the prose-phrase prompt greps in test_prompt_pins_classification_and_anti_false_positive_contract with an observable-behavior assertion (or drop them), since they only guard the LLM prompt's wording.
evidence: def test_prompt_pins_classification_and_anti_false_positive_contract(required: str) -> None: assert required.casefold() in _prompt_text().casefold()

The reviewer prompt src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_evidence_kind.md is rendered to an LLM; no parser/validator branches on these phrases, so per the Rule-5 litmus (LLM is not a non-human consumer) this is source/wording grepping.
advisory.finding: test_prompt_pins_classification_and_anti_false_positive_contract asserts free-text PROSE phrases inside the reviewer prompt (an LLM-consumed instruction artifact), e.g. 'ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof', 'test run', 'AWS', 'database', 'abstain'. No non-human consumer parses these tokens, so the assertions guard the author's wording and break on a behavior-preserving reword of the prompt without any observable-behavior change — a change-detector, not a behavior verifier.
scenarios: A prompt-engineering reword that preserves the criterion's behavior (e.g. rephrasing 'abstain' as 'do not fire') breaks the test with no behavior change.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the evidence-kind Pass-1 criterion does not prescribe exact author-applicable fixes (remediation ownership).
evidence: Prompt: 'The remediation must show the exact syntax `- [ ] [operator-attested] …`'
Prompt finding contract: 'Make the remediation an edit the author can apply directly.'

This is a Pass-1 criterion (exec:AGENT, registered in CANONICAL_LLM/AGENT_TIER); Pass 1 must not prescribe a fix (suggested_fix absent/empty). Prescriptive/applicable-edit remediation is owned by the fix-prescription (Pass-4 coaching) boundary.
dropped.finding: The new Pass-1 plan-review criterion prompt directs the reviewer to author a directly-applicable, exact-syntax fix ('The remediation must show the exact syntax `- [ ] [operator-attested] …`' and 'Make the remediation an edit the author can apply directly'), prescribing an implementation fix that a Pass-1 discovery criterion must not supply.
scenarios: A Pass-1 evidence-kind finding is emitted carrying an exact author-applicable remediation edit, assigning fix-prescription to the discovery phase.
